info.name: Integration API V2
info.description: Option B bidirectional contract. A V2 API key selected at key creation is required. The partner owns durable permit-package storage; BPH provides one-hour signed URLs and supports re-GET for refreshed URLs. Ingest on `permit_application_package_ready`, not on `permit_application_status_changed`. Meeting requests remain in BPH and are outside External API V2. Partners write canonical application statuses and are authoritative; project-state write-back and manual-status conflict UX are deferred.

item.name: Permit applications
item.description: Application statuses: `new_draft` (Draft), `newly_submitted` (Submitted), `in_review` (In review), `revisions_requested` (Revisions requested), `resubmitted` (Resubmitted), `approved` (Approved), `issued` (Issued), `withdrawn` (Withdrawn). Partner-writable statuses: `in_review`, `approved`, `issued`, `withdrawn`.

request.description: Slim application resource: identity and submission version index. Does not include submission_data or zip files.

Frozen submission snapshot for one version, including form data, generated PDFs, zipfile (File object, null if that version never received a zip), and signed file URLs. Ingest after permit_application_package_ready. URLs expire in one hour; re-GET to refresh.

Uses canonical BPH status codes. Lifecycle transitions are enforced and repeated writes of the current status are idempotent. Invalid, reserved, or unavailable transitions return 422 with the allowed write set.

Permit projects
item.description: Project GET follows `permit_project_id` from application reads and webhooks. Child summaries omit drafts and include `revisions_requested`. Meetings, collaborators, notes, and documents stay in BPH.

request.description: Project identity, state, address, and sibling application summaries (id, number, status, status_label, tags).

item.name: Webhook events

request.description: Development only. Point a V2 key webhook URL at this same address, then GET it to see the last deliveries.

item.description: V2 emits `permit_application_status_changed` for each externally visible application status transition, including submission and resubmission. Payload: `{ permit_application_id, permit_project_id, submission_version_id, status, status_label, occurred_at }`. Durable ingest waits for `permit_application_package_ready` (`{ permit_application_id, permit_project_id, submission_version_id, number, reference_number, occurred_at }`), which fires once per submission version after generated PDFs exist and the application zip is rebuilt. V2 also emits `permit_project_state_changed` with `{ permit_project_id, state, state_label, occurred_at }`. Project states: `draft` (Draft), `queued` (Queued), `waiting` (Waiting), `in_progress` (In progress), `ready` (Ready), `permit_issued` (Permit issued), `active` (Active), `complete` (Completed), `closed` (Closed). Timestamps are Unix epoch milliseconds. All bodies use the `{ event, payload }` envelope and `X-Webhook-Signature` HMAC-SHA256 header. File URLs are not included in webhooks; fetch them after package_ready. In development, set the key webhook URL to `{{webhook_url}}`.
